xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4653: Auto-settle a conversation when its linked PR merges (replaces auto-archive on merge)

plan.title: Auto-settle a conversation when its linked PR merges (replaces auto-archive on merge)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 28 files across server, frontend, CLI and docs, but every surface is required by the issue itself (sweep behavior, per-conversation override in the row menu and pan conv, a Settings toggle, a CLI verb, removal of the old key): this issue is already the PAN-4639 split product, the 8 items are small vertical slices, and splitting further would ship a setting with no way to change it or an override with no effect.

narratives.Problem: The PR sync sweep archives an operator conversation when all its linked PRs merge or close (conversations.auto_archive_on_merge, default off, CLI-only). Archiving is destructive, it skips live sessions through a tmux-only liveness read that is wrong under Herdr, and PAN-4639 now offers a non-destructive Settled state that fits the 'this work is done' signal better.
narratives.Proposal: On the same open → merged/closed transition, when every live link is merged or closed, settle the conversation (settled_at = now, settle_reason = 'merge') through the PAN-4639 triage store instead of archiving, with no liveness read. A new app_settings key conversations.auto_settle_on_merge (default on) is exposed in Settings → Conversations and as pan conv auto-settle-on-merge; a per-conversation override column auto_settle_override (on/off/inherit) is exposed in the row and tab menus and as pan conv auto-settle <query>. Agent conversations, already-settled conversations and conversations snoozed into the future are skipped. The old key and verb are removed.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Auto-settle when idle (PAN-4655)
- Archiving, stopping, or reading terminal liveness from the PR sync sweep
- Migrating or reading conversations.auto_archive_on_merge, deleting its stale app_settings row, or an auto-archive-on-merge alias
- A new settle reason for closed-without-merge PRs (they use 'merge')
- Showing the settle reason or an override badge in the conversation list
- Hiding the override submenu for agent conversations in the tab menu
- GitLab merge-request transitions
- A new event type for list refresh
- An undo entry or Undo toast for override changes

autoDecisions.summary: Remove conversations.auto_archive_on_merge and pan conv auto-archive-on-merge outright; no alias, no migration of the old value.
autoDecisions.rationale: The behavior (archive → settle) and the default (off → on) both changed, so an alias or a fallback read would silently mean something different; the old key was opt-in and CLI-only.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the existing trigger and gate: only the open → merged/closed transition fires, and only when every live link is merged or closed.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the drop-in reading of 'the same transition' in the issue, keeps the existing tests' semantics, and makes the settle fire once so an unsettle sticks.

autoDecisions.summary: A PR closed without merging also settles the conversation, with settle_reason 'merge'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the open → merged/closed transition; the reason enum from PAN-4639 has no 'closed' value and adding one is out of scope.

autoDecisions.summary: A conversation snoozed until a future time is not auto-settled and keeps its snooze.
autoDecisions.rationale: Settling clears snoozed_until (PAN-4639 D3) and would silently drop an explicit operator reminder; skipping costs only a manual settle after the wake.

autoDecisions.summary: Store the override as a nullable column written through the existing POST /api/conversations/triage door (autoSettleOverride field), exposed as 'inherit' when NULL.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the triage store, route and enrichment so the list gets the field with no extra query and no new per-conversation route.

autoDecisions.summary: Global setting gets its own GET/POST /api/conversations/auto-settle-on-merge routes and a self-contained Settings row component.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue rules out the YAML ConversationSettingsSection/settings-api.ts path and points at the app_settings toggle pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: Two CLI verbs: auto-settle-on-merge [on|off] (global) and auto-settle <query> [on|off|inherit] (override).
autoDecisions.rationale: One optional positional cannot distinguish a conversation query from on/off.
